# DeepSeek TUI Cloud

Run DeepSeek TUI as a hosted DeepSeek-TUI workspace with DeepSeek V4 routing, approvals, rollback, sessions, MCP, HTTP/SSE, and cost visibility for coding work.

Website: https://deepseek-tui.space/
Pricing: https://deepseek-tui.space/pricing/
Checkout: https://deepseek-tui.space/checkout/
Support: support@aigeamy.com
Type: Hosted SaaS workflow product

Problem:
- Teams need a quotable product definition, pricing path, evidence trail, and checkout route.

Solution:
- DeepSeek TUI Cloud provides a hosted workflow with public pricing, structured evidence, support contact, and report or receipt outputs.
